thread.topic: Application for CS:GO surf Deathmatch server.

posts.subject: Application for CS:GO surf Deathmatch server.
posts.bodyHtml:
0) Do I meet the requirements?
Answer: Yes and no, i do meet everything else that the basic knowlegde of german, but i have asked Mario, Becks, Vengeance and a few more which i cannot remember, if i should apply for an admin and they said go for it.
_______________________________


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is: Daniel Nordlund Thygesen
and my ingame name is Dolster/Ploiken


2) How old are you?
I am 16, VERY soon to be 17 >(17/6/1998)


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
This is the reason why i wanted to apply in the first place.


There have been alot of times when i've joined the SurfDM server and there was alot of people who were breaking the rules, and i called for an admin, and only a few of those times an admin came to help. (as of what i remember)


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
On the surf deathmatch server i've been playing for over 174 hours, since the reset. But me and my friend was playing on the server before the first reset/before the DDOS attack, which is a little over 5 month ago, says mario. (i am writing this with him :D)


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
Gaming, basically.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature?


Yes, since i've had a rough childhood, with bullying and with my mother having sclerose.
With all of that i've had to mature quicklier than other people to take hand of adult situations. [google] (i needed to get that emoticon in there)


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
no, but i have watched and learned, and "tried" to act like one, by telling people that they need to stop before i call an admin.


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
i play at least once every two days, but useally it's 2-12 hours a day.


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
i would tell the person to stop and let him go off with a warning, and if not then kick the person.
And if it so would happen that he rejoins and keep continuing insulting i would ban him for the reason and pusinment equal to "Ingoring admins"


10) Strengths
English
Tolerance
Respect


11) Weaknesses
German
Pets being killed


12) Conclusion / Closing remark
i'm only applying for the surfDM server since i dont "feel" fit for the other servers.
and as i am writing this someone needs my help, with getting an admin. alot of people are spawnkilling right now, this is basically the reason why i applied.


Anyways bye. 🙂
I think you would be a great admin. Nothing more to say. 👍

Totally a YES from my side, even though your activity (Forum) isn't that high but i think you can't really change that because there is almost nobody registered ín the forums that's actually not german. I dont really see any other cons though 👍

I'm going to make a positive (+) negative (-) list.
+ Active on servers
+ nice to the other players
+ youre known by all the stamm-players


+- Application


- raging often in matchmaking, hope you wont be like that on the servers.


All in all i think its a clear yes.


Benni

Hey Ploiken,


after sky talked to you, you will get a chance as an Admin in our Team.


You just know the english language, but you always stand behind our community and don't want to abuse with your rights.
You are active on the Server and also known in our Community.


We hope you will use your chance as first no german Admin.


Welcome in Team!


[angenommen-new*]


Greetz,
